notes: Matched teacher run architecture, optimizer, 1000 steps, data RNG, simulated observation seed and batch sizes; distinct GPUs may cause numerical variation. Same R17 and real-gain parents.

For each simulated source U received/clean pair, select the expert whose recovered waveform has lower clean IQ MSE; train disturbed gate BCE + 0.5 clean gate BCE. New selector reads no pretrained classifier, U TX, source V or target.
LoRa real-gain expert has prior authorized E104 guidance and U pseudo-labels; WiSig gain expert is independently source-trained F-free. Source-only status applies to new selector, not all ancestors.

Source V panels are repeatedly exposed; same fixed matched physical packets, controls, per-half thresholds and clean tolerances. This is a source-only mechanism comparison with complete cost disclosures, not formal target acceptance.
